environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate, connecting to Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15.4. Database user is 'app_service' with standard grants (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tenant tables. Tables have a tenant_id column but no RLS policies are enabled - the previous DBA left before completing the migration. The SET app.current_tenant command executes but no policy references it. Connection is direct from service to RDS with no proxy layer.

config.network: ECS Fargate direct to RDS via security group
